---
name: Catalog suggestion or correction
about: Request a project, suggest a paid alternative, or correct a source or price.
title: "[Catalog] "
---

Paste the draft from the website's Contribute page here, or fill in the sections below. Public information only. A submission is a research lead and requires review before entering the catalog.

## Open-source project

Project name and repository URL, including the relevant community/enterprise scope.

## Paid alternative or correction

Product name, or describe what needs correcting. Leave unknown facts unconfirmed.

## Official source

Vendor homepage, pricing, license or terms URL. Include a review date if known.

## Evidence and limitations

Explain overlapping features and differences. For a price, include currency, billing unit, payment cycle, region and configuration. Paid does not automatically mean proprietary.
